acceptance_criteria.text: Every change preserves the existing functional and visual assertions; no baseline, mask, threshold, or skip is changed to hide a regression.
Canonical data, provider, entitlement, history, and provenance limitations remain visible and accurately documented.
Changed frontend tests, full frontend checks, and the exhaustive integration gate pass.

goal_objective: Advance feat/tc2000-frontend-rework: Execute docs/tc2000-roadmap.md to deliver the canonical-data-backed, V25-inspired TC2000 workstation and stop at ready_for_human_review.. Acceptance criteria: AC1: Every change preserves existing functional and visual assertions; no baseline, mask, threshold, or skip is changed to hide a regression.; AC2: All eight benchmark families expose explicit canonical readiness, provider entitlement, point-in-time holdings/classification/weights/history, continuity, provenance, and unsupported-role states without silent fallback or fabricated data.; AC3: The live-data top-down workflow links benchmark, style, sector, industry/proxy, and constituent views with synchronized symbols/timeframes, indicators, drawings, keyboard behavior, save/restore, source lock/edit states, and actionable freshness.; AC4: Current and historical breadth contracts support generic condition predicates, denominator/exclusion/member-level/source lineage evidence, derived-series semantics, and supported ratio/history queries.; AC5: Market Map, breadth, rotation, ranking, leadership, concentration, dispersion, drawdown, volatility, correlation, and seasonality consumers use source-polymorphic, period-aware, bounded, provenance-visible contracts where data supports them.; AC6: Python/Study Lab outputs remain immutable and lineage-preserving while compatible shapes promote to columns, filters, scans, gauges, alerts, chart plots, and strategy signals with explicit capability errors.; AC7: The mapped V25 reference states are implemented and validated across source selection, treemap geometry, breadth/study/promotion, loading/error/freshness, keyboard, tool menus, popouts, and state restoration using the unchanged visual acceptance policy.; AC8: Golden Layout and native/browser window resilience, endurance beyond 100 rounds, 100k-point/10k-row performance, accessibility, security, sandbox, migration, and logging checks provide actionable evidence.; AC9: Focused backend/frontend/unit/integration checks, authenticated browser flows, all four visual projects, provider/data probes, and the final exact-tip exhaustive integration gate pass or record an explicit reproducible blocker.; AC10: The branch stops at ready_for_human_review with clean, synchronized branch-owned workstream records and no integration, promotion, deployment, or mutation of another worktree.. Required local profile: full_stack_browser. Stop at ready_for_human_review; do not integrate, promote, deploy, or modify another worktree.
